entries.name: MeshBench/qemu
entries.detail: Fork of qemu-project/qemu, branch meshbench-main. Adds an SX1262 LoRa radio device upstream does not have, with the DIO1 line the driver waits on, so ESP32 firmware sees its chip and hears it answer. The emulator in this bundle is built from this fork; the fork repository is the source offer, and every release carries a source archive beside the binaries. The application can also fetch this build into the tools directory on demand, which is how a source checkout obtains it.

entries.detail: Builds meshcore-dev/MeshCore applications unmodified and adds the host variant and bridge that let them run as plain processes. MeshBench downloads these builds at runtime; they are not in this bundle. Its NOTICE is reproduced below.
entries.text:
# Provenance

Binaries released from this repository are built from
[meshcore-dev/MeshCore](https://github.com/meshcore-dev/MeshCore), which is MIT
licensed, copyright Scott Powell / rippleradios.com. Their applications are
compiled **unmodified**; everything this repository adds is the host variant in
`variants/host/` and the bridge in `bridge/`, also MIT.

The commit each release was built from is recorded in that release's body.

Third-party code compiled in:

| what | source | licence |
|---|---|---|
| MeshCore | meshcore-dev/MeshCore | MIT |
| Crypto | rweather/arduinolibs | MIT |
| ed25519 | vendored in MeshCore under `lib/ed25519` | as MeshCore ships it |

The Cayenne LPP constants in `variants/host/CayenneLPP.h` and the base64
implementation in `variants/host/base64.hpp` are ours, written against published
formats rather than copied, so that a build does not need the network to resolve
values that have not changed in a decade.

## Why this is a separate repository

The simulator these builds run under has not chosen a licence. Linking MeshCore
constrains that choice, so the linking happens here, under MeshCore's own terms,
and the simulator downloads the result.

entries.name: CARTO basemaps
entries.detail: The light and dark basemap styles.
entries.text: Basemap style and tiles (c) CARTO, map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.

entries.detail: The satellite basemap.
entries.text: Imagery (c) Esri and its data partners: Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS user community.

entries.name: Terrain Tiles on AWS
entries.detail: Elevation for hillshade, link budgets and the cut-through profiles (Mapzen terrarium tiles).
